notes.title: Steam Power + Letters - Lumbermill Devlog
notes.content:
Steam Power has finally arrived in Lumbermill - this devlog covers how I implemented it, along with a new letters system and an improved inventory interface.

[previewyoutube=PBLdf2tDo9o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Upgrading the Island Map!
notes.content:
I first implemented the island map in July 2020. I only built the bare minimum features required though to get it up and running, leaving many of the key features for later in development. In this devlog, I've begun work on some of those features, including a screen to display information about islands, allowing different players to own islands, and also improving the pixel art sprites for the map!

[previewyoutube=Y8tutuzQCC0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Lumbermill has been in development for 2 Years!
notes.content:
Lumbermill has changed a lot since I first started working on the game, and I've put together this video to get everyone up to date on what has happened in the last 2 years.

[previewyoutube=zW8uvrxfw_A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Lumbermill devlog: Off-Island Trade + More!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I've decided it's probably time to start sharing the game's devlogs here, as many of you may not be aware that you can follow development of Lumbermill through YouTube. The latest devlog is here, and covers the latest additions to the trade systems, and an overhaul to one of the key parts of how Islands are generated!

[previewyoutube=HtnNGGUvOnk;full][/previewyoutube]
